Can you explain the main options in simple terms?
We keep it straightforward with two main ways to select your luggage.
First, you can design a custom case from scratch, selecting individual colors for the front and back shells, trim, zipper, and wheels, finished with a complimentary monogram. Second, you can choose from our Designer Collection, which features ready-to-order, curated colorways developed by our design team.
Both options come in standard carry-on and checked sizes, each assembled by hand in our Georgia workshop.

turns.q: How do I use it properly the very first time?
turns.replyTail:
o I use it properly the very first time?
menu
To use your ROAM suitcase for the first time, start by unlocking it: turn the dials to 000. Press the small reset button with a paper clip until it clicks, select your new 3-digit combination, and slide the lock button toward the dials to store it.
When packing, use the dual compression boards by stacking your folded clothes, placing bulkier items around them, and tightening the straps to keep everything locked in place.
